checks: The original input ZIP and self are registered before interpretation; the retained ZIP copy is marked pending before copy, registered by complete bytes/hash/mode after copy and included in unconditional after-check.

Every outer file is read to EOF with exact uncompressed length, complete SHA256 and CRC32. Unsafe names, encryption and nonregular member types fail. The exact three inner control files are selected only under the fixed observed outer prefix.

The custody declares original FAIL and incomplete whole stack, and exact inner/index bytes/hash/counts are required before tar interpretation. This reader cannot upgrade the original result by obtaining a different artifact.
Every tar member must be unique, safe, regular, exact size/mode, uid/gid/mtime0, and fully hashed against the index; the complete member set and260366769raw byte total must match.
All inner members are retained, not only summaries. Original byte copies are never substituted by reserialized parsed JSON.

Every named zlib/gzip CAS is streamed with a bounded decode chunk, required progress, complete stream EOF, no unused/trailing data, and decoded SHA matching the hash filename. Referenced CAS is additionally decoded and matched to its record's full logical bytes/hash.

MATERIALIZED and PENDING are separate; failure does not cause an incomplete copy to be called complete. Finally visits all registered inputs/materialized files independently and records partials without silently discarding them.

The member index maps each archived actual original absolute path to one or more archived copies. Every matched copy must equal the expected full size/SHA before it can support a source/image/executable row.
The baseline six compiles and new thirteen-entry list are correlated by exact prefix equality; baseline/optimized native packer counts remain one plus one, as original recorded observations.

Both role maps must have exactly string keys1..63. Every selected role's complete source and image bytes are checked. Seven changed identities are pinned independently; the other56 identities equal the actual baseline.

Each of13 compiler receipt rows must be returned/ABI0, bind exact historical35ee compiler, exact input source bytes/hash and exact produced image bytes/hash, and retain10CPU/256MiB/1MiB output/workspace plus recorded wall<20s and original source unchanged.
Every profile preserves original128functions/1536blocks/8192ops/256functionblocks/16blockparams/SSA suffix<2048.
Both baseline and selected executable full bytes/hash are resolved from the member index; original executable SHA relation is checked.
source_and_receipt_binding.limitation: This is validation of sealed recorded source/image/receipt/executable bytes. It does not rerun a compiler or packer, independently prove every internal receipt assertion by reexecution, or infer native entry/role timings.

checks: Thirteen exact group names/counts are fixed. Original plan labels, summary labels, group, planned counts, actual process/reference counts and failure status must agree.
Each pending and process row shares the exact label; process.stdin must equal the complete pending input record and executable SHA must equal the selected full executable.
The input frame's complete8words are matched to magic, per-index lease, version, digits, program/request lengths and zeros. The complete tail must equal resolved program bytes plus request bytes.
Every expected output object is resolved from its original CAS, then compared as complete bytes to stdout/stderr. There is no elapsed/hash/header masking.

Successful error cases require exact exit2, empty stdout, complete terminal frame and full original error payload. Successful result cases require exact exit0, complete128byte stderr terminal and full result frame including candidate/receipt/impact payloads.
Each of327 original completed cases must match its completed row status/label, all16terminal words and recorded elapsed; a mismatch fails the reader.

The two CPU-failed groups retain zero completed cases and no completed-row file. Their raw process before/after CPU, return code, timeout, input/stdout/stderr, expected bytes and any terminal are read. A derived byte comparison cannot turn them into a qualification pass.
Exactly329recorded processes,327completedcases,11passedgroups and2failedgroups must be accounted. The seven-role optimization cannot be relabeled as a whole-stack pass.
process_and_record_association.timing_boundary: Only recorded original subprocess-interval wall and parent-plus-reaped-child CPU deltas are described. No internal HIA role timings, entry counts, flush frontier cause or performance-root-cause inference is made.

The complete newly derived329process comparison is written to recorded-stream-comparison.json and explicitly not exported as original bytes.
Reader finally measures complete self plus reaped-child CPU and wall after input/materialized/partial inspections, writes and rereads final indexes and summary, and measures again.

limitations: No original ZIP was downloaded or inspected by this reviewer, so file counts and original outcomes here are assertions reviewed in source, not new observations.
The reader's own external180wall containment must remain supplied by its workflow; the standalone reader source uses final measurement and RLIMIT_CPU, not an in-process wall alarm.

correct_scope: The transport selects exact artifact/run/head/name/size/digest/nonexpiry from original metadata and writes the raw metadata bytes.
The API redirect is followed using a fresh request without forwarding repository authorization to storage.
The complete stream is capped at exact expected size, hashed before rename, then full-byte read back. Source input is unchanged-checked, and partial file is retained on fetch failure.
Transport imports only stdlib and starts no target process. Expected artifact identity and source/original failures remain immutable.

findings.fact: Transport used/elapsed are sampled at lines94-95 before receipt JSON serialization/write and final stdout print; lines103-105 then write/print and disable the alarm without a final strict post-tail CPU/wall comparison.
findings.boundary: The active180wall alarm limits much of this tail, but the emitted measured receipt still excludes it and no final measuredCPU<90 andwall<180 condition is checked after it. This differs from the reader's correctly completed post-stdout gate.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep the current90/180 limits and alarm; after the last required receipt/output write or flush, measure final used/elapsed and fail at>=90 or>=180s. Record a separate late-budget receipt or update status without relabeling earlier original bytes.

findings.fact: The transport finally block performs own.read_bytes and PASS-output stat/digest with unprotected exceptions before constructing the receipt. A missing/changed/unreadable source or failed final output readback can exit that finally before saving the already collected primary transport error/phase and structured after-check outcome.
findings.minimal_fix: Capture each after-check failure independently, preserve the original error/phase and append after-check errors, then emit a FAIL receipt with partial/output status. An after-check failure must never produce PASS.
findings.boundary: Existing raw metadata/partial or complete output is not deleted by the code. This finding concerns structured failure finalization and primary error retention; it is not evidence of lost original files.

exclusions: No original target tests, compiler, ELF, HIA or Python project source was executed.
No missing target result or failed large group is upgraded or requalified.
No C/Python/VM performance improvement or internal native role timing is inferred.
No external payload authentication claim is established by recorded scalar fields.
No ordinary Worker/Store/namespace or installed/cold closure claim is made.
